constructions.latent_object: F(phi), where phi ranges over the equivalence class of the polynomial x*y + x*z under the distributive law a*(b+c)=a*b+a*c

hypotheses.latent_object: F(phi), where phi ranges over the equivalence class of the polynomial x*y + x*z under the distributive law a*(b+c)=a*b+a*c
hypotheses.construction_plan: Fix the canonical expanded argument phi0 = x*y + x*z. The first target term is F(phi0). The second target term is obtained by specializing phi to the factored representative x*(y + z) in the same equivalence class.
required_assumptions: x, y, z are elements of an algebraic structure where multiplication distributes over addition
proof_obligations: Show x*(y + z) equals x*y + x*z under the distributivity axiom.
Show both target members are applications of the same unary kernel F to representatives of this equivalence class.
hypotheses.rationale: The raw expression is a sum of two F-terms whose arguments are syntactically different but structurally related by the distributive law; this is naturally a repeated kernel over an argument equivalence class.
